rule: NAMES + classification + intended state ONLY. No secret VALUE ever appears here. Names were recovered from accepted source and cross-checked against the packet.

source_name_reconciliation.note: Every §9 packet-provided variable NAME exists byte-identically in the accepted source (recovered via server/voice-gateway/config.ts + live-ai-staging-main.ts + lib/live-ai/staging-authority.ts + openai-responses.ts). No name conflict. (Source also carries a parallel LIVE_AI_03B_* budget-timing family — LIVE_AI_03B_LEASE_TTL_MS / LIVE_AI_03B_CONTROL_STALENESS_MS — but the budget core reads the LIVE_AI_BUDGET_* family; the LIVE_AI_BUDGET_* names below are the ones consumed by resolveBudgetConfig in config.ts.)
source_name_reconciliation.operator_subject_separator: Accepted source lib/live-ai/staging-authority.ts derives the staging subject as HMAC-SHA256(secret, DOMAIN + NUL + adminId) where the SEP literal is a NUL byte (U+0000) — the file's `const SEP` is a single \u0000, matching packet §17 ('domain + NUL + verified_admin_id'). No conflict.

variables.name: LIVE_AI_03B_STAGING_DATABASE_URL
variables.intended_state: PRESENT at runtime; MUST resolve to AI-STAGING Postgres b7362594-a01b-4623-a982-394707a6cec2; value never logged

variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
variables.intended_state: ABSENT during NON-SPEND preparation; PRESENT only at the FIRST-PROBE ARM step; REMOVED at IMMEDIATE CLOSE. Presence-only check ever; value never printed or persisted.

variables.name: LIVE_AI_RUNTIME_ENABLED
variables.intended_state: set per the gate sequence for the isolated staging runtime; not a spend gate on its own

variables.name: LIVE_AI_SESSION_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY
variables.intended_state: PRESENT; MUST correspond to the broker-side private key (verify by a safe derived public-key fingerprint, never the private key)

variables.name: LIVE_AI_SESSION_ISSUER
variables.intended_state: identical issuer string on broker + gateway

variables.name: LIVE_AI_SESSION_AUDIENCE
variables.intended_state: identical audience string on broker + gateway

variables.name: LIVE_AI_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
variables.intended_state: bounded to the isolated staging operator surface

variables.name: LIVE_AI_03B_STAGING_TEXT_ENABLED
variables.intended_state: OFF (!= '1') during preparation; turned ON only at the FIRST-PROBE ARM step; OFF FIRST at IMMEDIATE CLOSE

variables.name: LIVE_AI_03B_STAGING_SUBJECT_ALLOWLIST
variables.intended_state: the reviewed staging subject allowlist (opaque stg1.* subject(s)); default []

variables.name: LIVE_AI_03B_FIRST_PROBE_ONE_CALL
variables.intended_state: OFF (default); ON only for the single deterministic probe

variables.name: LIVE_AI_03B_STAGING_BROKER_ENABLED
variables.intended_state: OFF during preparation; turned ON LAST at ARM; OFF FIRST at IMMEDIATE CLOSE

variables.name: LIVE_AI_03B_STAGING_OPERATOR_SUBJECT
variables.intended_state: EXACTLY ONE opaque subject stg1.<64 lowercase hex>; derived from the VERIFIED admin id via HMAC-SHA256(secret, DOMAIN + NUL + adminId); a list-shaped value fails closed

variables.name: LIVE_AI_03B_STAGING_SUBJECT_HMAC_SECRET
variables.intended_state: PRESENT; the dedicated subject-derivation secret; never JWT_ACCESS_SECRET / signing keys; value never logged

variables.name: LIVE_AI_SESSION_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY
variables.intended_state: PRESENT on the broker ONLY; MUST correspond to the gateway public key (safe fingerprint check only); value never logged

variables.name: LIVE_AI_GATEWAY_URL
variables.intended_state: the AI-STAGING gateway base URL the broker forwards to (never a CORE URL, never an arbitrary provider URL)
